title: emiMkt_budgetFeas_noRefresh

description: Off-arm for the RE-OPEN BUDGET REFRESH (reopenRefresh ~0 = never refresh). title: emiMkt_budgetFeas_refresh8
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: ON-arm for the RE-OPEN BUDGET REFRESH at a threshold it can actually reach: reopenRefresh 8 (= maxWindow) instead of the shipped 24. Across all 28 data12 runs, 43 targets settled long enough and 11 exhausted their budget but NOT ONE did both, so the feature has never been observed to do anything and 24 is effectively untestable inside a 100-iteration cap. Read as a THREE-point comparison: emiMkt_budgetFeas (24, expected inert here), this arm (8, can fire), emiMkt_budgetFeas_noRefresh (off). If 8 does not differ from off, the mechanism does nothing even when it is able to fire. Diagnostic arm - NOT a proposed default.
